task_fulfillment.rationale: The single supplied Word SOP substantially covers daily warehouse activities, training, verification and records. Material corrections remain: task-required ESD gloves are omitted, storage inserts/trays are unaddressed, and transport exceptions weaken the outside-EPA packaging rule. The document cites IPC-A-610G but acknowledges that the full text was unavailable, so substantive use of that reference is not established. Approval of proposed company-specific values is reasonable, not an unnecessary hold. No cross-file inconsistency is observable because no companion files were supplied. The five-page limit and visual usability remain unverified rendering endpoints.
